Rules.InvariantScript:
"data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(
  "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 640 640'><polyline fill='none' stroke='#FFC857' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' points='" &
  Concat(
    Sequence(ctxSpiN),
    With(
      {th: sldSpiTurns.Value * 2 * Pi() * Value / 600, rr: 290 * Value / 600},
      Text(320 + rr * Cos(th), "0.0") & "," &
      Text(320 - rr * Sin(th), "0.0")
    ),
    " "
  ) &
  "'/></svg>"
)
"r(θ) = a·θ      the Archimedean spiral grows by a constant amount each turn"
